description: Evaluation set for Ask My Course, grounded in the 'Fundamentals of Environmental Science' demo course. Used by run_eval.py to measure Retrieval@k, answer correctness, and guardrail accuracy.

scoring.retrieval_hit: For an 'answerable' question, retrieval is a HIT if any of the top-k returned chunks comes from one of expected_pages.
scoring.answer_correct: Rough automatic proxy: the fraction of answer_key terms that appear in the answer text. A question passes if it meets the pass_ratio in run_eval.py.
scoring.guardrail_correct: answerable -> should NOT be refused; out_of_scope -> SHOULD be refused; smalltalk -> should get the friendly reply, not a refusal.
